title: PM-Eng 1:1 prep - Aisha Rahman / Leo Martinez 2026-02-25
content:
Meeting: PM <> Eng lead 1:1
Date: 2026-02-25
Time: 09:30am PT (30m)
Attendees: Aisha (PM), Leo (Eng Lead) — quick check-ins from Priya if needed

Goals for this 1:1:
- Align on immediate priorities across API, Console, Dedicated, Private deployments
- Surface blockers and resource needs for Dedicated capacity commit
- Confirm canary/rollback plan for console rollout next week
- Follow up on action items from last 1:1

Agenda (high level)
1) Quick updates (5 min)
   - Hosting/API metrics: p95 latency, error spikes, cost signals
   - Console: staging->canary readiness
2) Deep dive: KV cache memory leak (INF-3421) impact & mitigation (8 min)
3) Dedicated capacity contract + infra implications (5 min)
4) Private deployment checklist: KMS, audit logs, network egress (5 min)
5) Roadmap/hiring ask + any escalations (rest)

Notes / talking points (bullet-style, unpolished):
- API: observed p95 generation latency ~120ms (last 24h) but tail jumps to 420ms during spikes - likely due to cold KV entries + bursty small-requests workload. Need to confirm if batching tuning would help; ask infra to run perf-run with batch window 30ms vs 100ms.
- Cost: embeddings usage jumped by ~18% (marketing experiments). Might need budget guardrail; recommend temporary quota until we have cost-per-embedding dashboard.
- INF-3421 (kv-cache): Leo - can you summarize root cause? My understanding: race in eviction path causing gradual growth; reproduces in staging with long-running sessions. Is there a quick mitigation (restart cadence + alert) while you work on fix?
- Console rollout (PR #412): staging smoke passed, but one UX regression flagged by UX: function call modal layout shift. Is it safe to canary with 5% traffic? We need explicit rollback criteria: increased error rate >0.5% or ttfb p95 +50ms.
- Dedicated: sales wants 3-month reserved capacity for a mid-market customer - need estimate of committed GPU-hours and what SLAs we can guarantee. Engineering ask: timeline to spin up dedicated pool with autoscale (baseline + burst).
- Private: customer asked about KMS/HSM integration timeline. We should confirm whether KMS support in Private GA includes envelope encryption + rotation docs. Also confirm audit-log retention options (30/90/365 days).

Questions for Leo (call prep):
- What is the ETA for kv-cache fix and do you recommend a hotfix or will a patch be staged in next sprint?
- Console canary: do we have the infra hooks to route by region & model variant? If not, what's missing?
- Dedicated pool: estimate for effort (days) to provision baseline + autoscaler + burst policy + SLA testing?
- Private KMS: dependency list (team/product/infra) and blocker items?

Follow-ups from last 1:1 (quick status):
- PR 412 (console): I asked for UX polish - Leo said team would address; status: in review (GH link above)
- Deploy rollback playbook: Priya to add runbook - status: draft (needs test run)
- Eval harness for model downgrade regressions: Samir owning; status: initial tests green, need more edge-case prompts

Action items (clear owners + rough due dates)
- Leo: Provide short mitigation plan for INF-3421 (restart cadence, alert thresholds) by 2026-02-27
- Leo + Infra: Run perf experiment for batching windows (30ms vs 100ms) and share perf numbers by 2026-03-03
- Aisha: Draft message for sales about Dedicated timelines & options (include cost ballpark) by 2026-02-26
- Priya: Finalize rollback playbook and run a dry-run in staging by 2026-02-28
- UX: Fix layout shift in function-call modal (owner: Jamie) - aim to merge before canary (2026-02-26)
- Security/Product: Confirm KMS/HSM support list for Private and update Confluence page by 2026-03-05

Notes-to-self / things to remember in the meeting:
- push for explicit rollback criteria for console (error rate, ttfb, side-effect failures)
- ask Leo whether batching/caching config can be surfaced as per-route knobs in Console
- confirm whether Dedicated customers will be able to pin model variants (important for enterprise legal/QA)

Post-meeting follow-ups (template) - copy to Slack #prod-console + add to weekly-sync doc:
- short recap of decisions (canary %, rollback criteria, hotfix plan)
- list of assigned action items + owners + due dates
- if any escalation needed, flag to GtM and CS

Random / scratch notes (may clean later):
- If we can expose per-route batching window in Console, product could recommend optimal defaults based on observed latency distributions - tie into Optimize suggestions
- Consider temporary rate-limits for embeddings endpoint for new signups to avoid cost shocks
- Check with infra on GPU pool fragmentation for Dedicated customers (small reservations cause extra allocation overhead)

End of prep notes.

-- Aisha
(quick, noisy draft - will tidy before posting to Slack/Confluence)
